sk.meta.description: A free course inside Avistry: 40 short skills in 6 tiers, from finding the Hierarchy to baking maps. Nothing is locked.
sk.title: Learn Unity as you go.
sk.lead: Forty skills in six tiers, from finding the Hierarchy to baking maps. Each is marked done when you do it in the tool. Nothing is locked.
sk.cta.how: How to start it in Unity
sk.how.title: Start it in Unity.
sk.how.2: Press Start the skill tree in the New to Unity? note at the top of the window. It opens the first thing to try.
sk.how.3: Or open the ? Help menu and choose Glossary and skill tree. Pick a skill, read the card and press Show me to try it.
sk.how.note: Progress is kept on your computer only, with medals for each tier. Reset skill progress clears it.
sk.nojs: This page needs JavaScript to show the skills. The same course is in the tool under Help.
sk.graduate.body: Finish every tier and you have the basics of Unity and of Avistry. Keep the glossary open whenever a word is new.

lr.help.body: Struggling with Avistry or with Unity itself? Ask in our Discord. Other creators and the maintainers help out, and no question is too small.
